_doc: Glassmere, on Luna (song bars 0-20, 44-64). The journey (2026-11-26): the rim of the still lake (bars 0-5, a ring round Glassmere, the ice dull; ripples to tap at 3); the Kindling rises off the lake at 4 with the ball (each tap turns gravity over); at 6 a ripple throws you to the ice stepping-stones (a line of floes, 7, Helion's moment); the drop (8): the great node, a beat of stillness, the impact, and you are thrown down onto the looking-lake, Glassmere itself, flipping across its surface on the beat (9-19), ripples throwing you, ice shards as walls; the riser accelerates (20-23), Vell: 'Come and see the other side.'; the second drop (24) throws you through the surface into the Underlake (25-35), the reflection world: the picture turns over at 26 (a mirror portal), a sprint at 2x (30), and the Underlake winds inward (31-35); at 36 the surface throws you back up, the camera pulls back over the whole relit lake, and the picture turns back as you land (37); the seal on the last stab (40).
Every bar is charted by hand (tools/journey.py from tools/journeys.py, then hand-tuned if need be). The id is the world's slot, not the song.
title: Luna
adds: The ball: each tap turns gravity over, across the lake's surface; mirror portals into its reflection

setpieces.name: The ball
setpieces.what: Glassmere's Kindling rises off the lake on the song's pulse and gives the ball: each tap turns gravity over

setpieces.name: The first ripple
setpieces.what: a ripple swells under you and throws you off the rim to the ice stepping-stones, a droplet to catch on the way

setpieces.name: Helion's moment
setpieces.what: his motif from far off on the thin bar; his silhouette in the shadow ring, clearer than in Cirra

setpieces.name: The looking-lake
setpieces.what: the drop: the great node, a beat of stillness, the impact; thrown down onto Glassmere itself, flipping across its surface on the beat

setpieces.name: Vell beneath
setpieces.what: Vell, under the water, mirrors every flip you make above

setpieces.name: The riser
setpieces.what: the build accelerates (1.5x), the camera pushes in; Vell: 'Come and see the other side.'

setpieces.name: Through the surface
setpieces.what: the second drop: the surface throws you through into the Underlake, the reflection world

setpieces.name: The mirror portal
setpieces.what: the picture turns over: you are in the reflection (cool light, the stars below as above), Vell real beside you

setpieces.name: The Underlake winds in
setpieces.what: at 2x the Underlake's ring winds inward, down toward its heart

setpieces.name: Back up
setpieces.what: the surface throws you back up; the camera pulls back over the whole relit lake; the picture turns back as you land

setpieces.name: The seal
setpieces.what: the last tap breaks the Stillness's seal on the star
